name: Titan
description: Qingtian, the patron saint of Nantianmen, works with King Kong to maintain order at the entrance to the heaven. It has the meaning of protecting the home, ensuring peace, helping utility, and bringing good luck, so it is quite auspicious to place it in your home. Qingtian's appearance is novel, the armor and machinery are exquisitely integrated, and the beast-swallowing elements are cleverly used. He is hard-core and domineering. Seeing that he is wearing a purple-blue battle armor, holding a magic weapon in his hand, and surrounded by auspicious clouds, he must be a good expert in bringing good luck to the house.
